info.title: samsung_smart_tv
info.description: Samsung Smart TV LAN API (S95C-focused modern Tizen subset)

get.summary: Canonical Smart View info endpoint for modern Samsung TVs. Returns device identity, model, firmware, and network details. Payload fields vary by model and firmware revision; unknown fields are preserved via flattened extras. For high-frequency polling, prefer conditional requests or payload diffing to reduce repeated owned-string allocations when firmware does not support ETag-style cache validation.

Payload fields vary by model and firmware revision; unknown fields are preserved via flattened extras. For high-frequency polling, prefer conditional requests or payload diffing to reduce repeated owned-string allocations when firmware does not support ETag-style cache validation.

get.summary: Debug/developer-facing log endpoint. May require developer mode enabled on the TV and can return non-success status when disabled.
get.description: Debug/developer-facing log endpoint. May require developer mode enabled on the TV and can return non-success status when disabled.

get.summary: Get the running status and metadata of a specific application. Returns visibility, running state, version, and name.
get.description: Get the running status and metadata of a specific application. Returns visibility, running state, version, and name.

put.summary: Install (or reinstall) an application by its ID. The TV downloads and installs the app from the Samsung app store.
put.description: Install (or reinstall) an application by its ID. The TV downloads and installs the app from the Samsung app store.

post.summary: Launch a Samsung application by its package ID. Firmware-dependent support; use when the Samsung app ID is known. Recommended runtime strategy: attempt this endpoint first, fall back to LaunchApplicationByName.
post.description: Launch a Samsung application by its package ID. Firmware-dependent support; use when the Samsung app ID is known. Recommended runtime strategy: attempt this endpoint first, fall back to LaunchApplicationByName.

delete.summary: Close a running application by its ID. Sends a DELETE to the application endpoint, which requests the TV terminate the app.
delete.description: Close a running application by its ID. Sends a DELETE to the application endpoint, which requests the TV terminate the app.

post.summary: Launch a Samsung application by name. Compatibility fallback for firmware that does not honor /api/v2/applications/{id}.
post.description: Launch a Samsung application by name. Compatibility fallback for firmware that does not honor /api/v2/applications/{id}.

SamsungDeviceInfoResponse.title: SamsungDeviceInfoResponse
SamsungDeviceInfoResponse.description:
Top-level response from the Samsung Smart View `/api/v2/` info endpoint.

Fields vary by model and firmware revision. The typed core covers fields
observed on S95C-class TVs; unknown fields are captured in `extra` to
preserve round-trip fidelity.

id.description: Device UUID assigned by the TV.

name.description: Human-readable device name (often the TV's network hostname).

SamsungDeviceInfo.title: SamsungDeviceInfo
SamsungDeviceInfo.description:
Nested device information block within the Smart View info response.

All fields are optional because firmware revisions may omit or rename
properties without notice.

FrameTVSupport.description: Whether the TV supports Frame/Art Mode (`"true"` or `"false"`).

TokenAuthSupport.description: Whether the TV supports token-based remote auth.

ip.description: TV's own IP address on the local network.

SamsungAppStatusResponse.title: SamsungAppStatusResponse
SamsungAppStatusResponse.description:
Response from the app status endpoint (`GET /api/v2/applications/{app_id}`).

Returns running state, version, and other metadata for a specific app.

running.description: Whether the app is currently running.

visible.description: Whether the app is currently visible on screen.
